title: fleet-guards: stderr redirect to $STATE defeats fleet_burn makedirs self-heal when state dir is gone
description: Codereview of rmza/jju8 interaction (correctness pass, kimi-k3). Guards invoke the helper as python3 ... 2>"$W_ERR" where W_ERR=$STATE/fleet_burn.err. Redirections open BEFORE the command runs, so if /tmp/fleet-driver-state vanished, the 2> open fails ENOENT and fleet_burn.py is never invoked — update()'s os.makedirs(state_dir, exist_ok=True) (rmza self-heal) never executes. WASTE empty every cycle, one deduped bd alarm, waste guard permanently blind until guards restart — the exact outcome the self-heal was added to eliminate. Fix: re-run mkdir -p "$STATE" inside the loop before the helper call (or move the err file outside $STATE).
